notes: 1) Label inconsistency inside the paper: text line ~357 says 'The straightforward mass counterparts of A2034S and A2034N, labelled as \#1 and \#2 respectively', but the mass-clump table footnotes give 1=star=A2034N and 2=diamond=A2034S; the table declinations (clump 1 at +33:33:43 north of clump 2 at +33:27:50) and BCG catalogue positions (BCG N +33:34:01.5, BCG S +33:29:10.4) support the table footnote (clump 1 = A2034N). 2) Mass peak positions are given only to 1 s in RA / 1 arcsec in Dec. 3) For A2034N no X-ray peak/gas clump exists per the paper, so x_G is not available for the designated subcluster. 4) For reference A2034S values (not designated): clump 2 at 15:10:09 +33:27:50; BCG S (ID 95 star) 15:10:11.7 +33:29:10.4; BCG S - mass peak 84 (+37/-32) arcsec; X-ray peak - BCG S 91+/-1 arcsec; X-ray peak - S mass peak 169 (+48/-42) arcsec. 5) Text also says BCG N within 1 sigma (68% c.l.) of its mass peak bootstrap contours. 6) A northern neighbour clump (#7, 15:10:17 +33:36:52) sometimes confused with the A2034N peak: 'far $199_{+45}^{-41}$ arcsec from the BCG N'.
